caption: What if Earth were flat? Squash our planet into a giant disc, like a roti. Today, ships disappear bottom first as they sail over the horizon; on a flat disc they would just shrink. Gravity would pull toward the centre of the disc, so walking toward the edge would feel like climbing a steeper and steeper hill. Air and oceans would slide toward the middle, leaving the edges with barely any air. In every lunar eclipse, Earth's shadow on the Moon is curved; a disc seen side-on would cast a straight edge. Eratosthenes measured Earth's size with shadows in the 3rd century BC, and in 499 CE Aryabhata wrote that Earth is a sphere that spins. Plot twist: a flat Earth couldn't even stay flat. Its own gravity would pull it back into a ball, in about an hour by one Caltech scientist's estimate. Which proof do YOU like best? 👇
